title: WordTrail <id>.content.json (written by the content agent)
description: Content the agent (Claude, via the wordtrail-lesson skill) prepares for one lesson. tools/build.py merges it with lessons/<id>.json into data/lessons/<id>.json. Every key of `items` is an items[].text from words.json. All item fields except `s`, `lemma` and `text_fixed` are copied as-is into data/lessons/<id>.json -> items[].content.

source_title_ru.description: Russian title of the source; becomes lesson.source.title_ru. A meaningful title, not a word-by-word translation of a truncated title.

sentences.description: Shared sentence translations, keyed by an arbitrary key (s1, s2, ...). Several items from one sentence point to the same key via `s`.

items.description: Key = items[].text from words.json, exactly (including typos).

display.description: Cleaned context shown instead of the editor sentence: split glued headings, removed captions/bylines/footnotes, shortened long paragraphs, fixed typos. Must still contain the item text (or text_fixed). The original goes to item.sentence_original.

ru.description: Russian translation of the (display) sentence; becomes item.content.sentence_ru.

en.description: Must contain a form of the word/phrase (build.py checks).

sentence_ru.description: Inline sentence translation (alternative to `s`, used by the first lesson). Prefer `s`.

lemma.description: Dictionary form, lowercase (except proper nouns used as words); for phrases the normal form (turned it down -> turn down, spinning -> spin up). Key in vocab.json: repeats are matched by lemma.

pos.description: noun, verb, adjective, adverb, preposition, phrasal verb, modal verb, idiom, ...

ipa.description: IPA in /slashes/, US accent, for the form as it appears in the text (awaited -> /əˈweɪtɪd/).

ru.description: Translation in THIS context (may list 2 close variants; 'здесь: ...' when the context meaning differs from the usual one).

ru_short.description: Card/table translation, about 1-4 words. Goes to vocab senses.

definition_en.description: Short learner-dictionary definition in English, for this meaning.

note_ru.description: 1-3 sentences in Russian: nuance, base meaning vs. context meaning, word family, collocations, what the agent changed in the context (typo, split, shortened).

examples.description: 2-3 natural examples, each with a form of the word/phrase.

suggest_phrase.description: The agent suggests learning a phrase instead of the single selected word (pick -> pick out, bleeding -> bleeding edge). Usually equals lemma.

text_fixed.description: Corrected item text when the source has a typo (showsomeone -> shows). Becomes item.text; the original goes to item.text_original.

flags.description: Short Russian notes about agent interventions, shown as badges: 'контекст очищен агентом', 'контекст разделён агентом', 'контекст сокращён агентом', 'в тексте опечатка: …'.

proper_noun.description: true: in the text the word is a name (Minion = Uber's tool); content explains the ordinary meaning.

short_context.description: true: the context is a heading/fragment, not a full sentence (exercises built on the sentence are less useful).

phonemes.description: For the on-device pronunciation trainer. ARPAbet (CMUdict style, US), stress digit on every vowel (1 primary, 2 secondary, 0 none), space-separated, for the item text as shown (after text_fixed). Multi-word items: words separated by ' | '. Example: resilient -> 'R IH0 Z IH1 L Y AH0 N T'; spin up -> 'S P IH1 N | AH1 P'.

collocations.description: Level 2+: typical collocations ('emit metrics', 'emit events'). Not shown by the app yet.

family.description: Level 2+: word family ('resilience (n)', 'resiliently (adv)'). Not shown by the app yet.

compare_ru.description: Level 2+: Russian comment comparing this context with the previous encounters (same sense or a shade). Not shown by the app yet.

synonyms.description: Level 3+: synonyms with nuance. Not shown by the app yet.

register_ru.description: Level 3+: register (formal/neutral/informal/technical) in Russian. Not shown by the app yet.

mistakes_ru.description: Level 3+: typical mistakes of Russian speakers. Not shown by the app yet.

story.description: Level 4+: mini-story (3-5 sentences) using this word and other words from vocab. Not shown by the app yet.
